CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0051_GET_NEW_INFO]
   @code   NVARCHAR(100)
 , @param1 NVARCHAR(200)
 , @param2 NVARCHAR(200)
 , @param3 NVARCHAR(200)
 , @param4 NVARCHAR(200)
 , @param5 NVARCHAR(200)
 , @param6 NVARCHAR(200)

AS

BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

 -- NERP 매핑코드
 DECLARE @v_PLANT_NJ NVARCHAR(8); -- G182
 SELECT @v_PLANT_NJ = dbo.FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP0051_GET_NEW_INFO','PLANT_ID')

 IF @Code = 'ItemProdPlanLinePopup'
	BEGIN
		IF @Param1 = 'EE'
			BEGIN
				SELECT a.ITEM_ID CODE
						,a.ITEM_ID NAME
						,PLANT_SITE_ID
						,c.SITE_DESCRIPTION
						,(select top 1 NICK_NAME from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID) NICK_NAME
						,CASE WHEN C.OSP_YN='Y' THEN (select top 1 ITEM_TYPE from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID AND (B.ITEM_TYPE='P' OR B.ITEM_TYPE='H'))
							  ELSE (select MIN(ISNULL(ITEM_TYPE,'Z')) from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID and b.site_id=c.site_id)
						 END ITEM_TYPE
						,OPERATION_ID
						,a.DIVISION_ID
						,C.OSP_YN
				FROM(
						SELECT distinct a.ITEM_ID, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, SUBSTRING(i.FLOW_ID,1,5) OPERATION_ID, a.division_id
						FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a (NOLOCK)
						JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.SCM_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID
						-- 테이블 변경
						LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ID
									  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
									 WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
									   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
									   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
									    ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
									   AND MONTH <= (  SELECT MAX(p.horizon_end_date) AS horizon_end_date
														 FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
														WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
														  AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
																				WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
																				  and plan_id < 9999)
																				)
													) B
							 ON A.DIVISION_ID	= B.DIVISION_ID
							AND A.ITEM_ID		= B.ITEM_ID
							AND C.PLANT_ID		= B.PLANT_ID

						LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM i (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
						LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.division_id=A.DIVISION_ID AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
						WHERE a.VALID_YN ='Y'
						AND (
									( C.OSP_YN='N' ) OR   -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y')
								)
						and ( @Param2='' or @Param2 is null or i.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
						AND (
									(C.OSP_YN='N' AND B.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL) OR  -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y' AND P.daily_capa_qty IS NOT NULL)
								)
						and ( @Param3='' or @

Param3 is null or a.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
				) a
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE c WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PLANT_SITE_ID = c.SCM_SITE_ID AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE a.DIVISION_ID IN ('40','81','82')
				order by a.item_id
			END
		ELSE IF @Param1 = 'EE_UC'
			BEGIN
				SELECT a.ITEM_ID CODE
						,a.ITEM_ID NAME
						,PLANT_SITE_ID
						,c.SITE_DESCRIPTION
						,(select top 1 NICK_NAME from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID) NICK_NAME
						,CASE WHEN C.OSP_YN='Y' THEN (select top 1 ITEM_TYPE from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID AND (B.ITEM_TYPE='P' OR B.ITEM_TYPE='H'))
							  ELSE (select MIN(ISNULL(ITEM_TYPE,'Z')) from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID and b.site_id=c.site_id)
						 END ITEM_TYPE
						,OPERATION_ID
						,a.DIVISION_ID
						,C.OSP_YN
				FROM(
						SELECT distinct a.ITEM_ID, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, SUBSTRING(i.FLOW_ID,1,5) OPERATION_ID, a.division_id
						FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a (NOLOCK)
						JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.SCM_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID
						-- 테이블 변경
						LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ID
									  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
									 WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
									   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
									   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
									    ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
									   AND MONTH <= (  SELECT MAX(p.horizon_end_date) AS horizon_end_date
														 FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
														WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
														  AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
																				WHERE ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
																				  and plan_id < 9999)
																				)
													) B
							 ON A.DIVISION_ID	= B.DIVISION_ID
							AND A.ITEM_ID		= B.ITEM_ID
							AND C.PLANT_ID		= B.PLANT_ID

						LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM i (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
						LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.division_id=A.DIVISION_ID AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
						WHERE a.VALID_YN ='Y'
						AND (
									( C.OSP_YN='N' ) OR   -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y')
								)
						and ( @Param2='' or @Param2 is null or i.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
						AND (
									(C.OSP_YN='N' AND B.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL) OR  -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y' AND P.daily_capa_qty IS NOT NULL)
								)
						and ( @Param3='' or @Param3 is null or a.DIVISION_ID=@Param3)
				) a
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE c WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PLANT_SITE_ID = c.SCM_SITE_ID AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
				WHERE a.DIVISION_ID IN ('81_UC')
				order by a.item_id
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
					SELECT a.ITEM_ID CODE
							,a.ITEM_ID NAME
							,PLANT_SITE_ID
							,c.SITE_DESCRIPTION
							,(select top 1 NICK_NAME from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID) NICK_NAME
							,CASE WHEN C.OSP_YN='Y' THEN (select top 1 ITEM_TYPE from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID AND (B.ITEM_TYPE='P' OR B.ITEM_TYPE='H'))
								  ELSE (select MIN(ISNULL(ITEM_TYPE,'Z')) from SCM_MST_ITEM_SN b WITH(NOLOCK) where b.ITEM_ID = a.ITEM_ID and b.site_id=c.site_id)
							 END ITEM_TYPE
							,OPERATION_ID
							,a.DIVISION_ID
							,C.OSP_YN
					FROM(
							SELECT distinct a.ITEM_ID, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, SUBSTRING(i.FLOW_ID,1,5) OPERATION_ID, a.DIVISION_ID
							FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a (NOLOCK)
							LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM i (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
							JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.SCM_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID
							-- 테이블 변경
							LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, PLANT_ID
									  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH

(NOLOCK)
									 WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = @Param1
									   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
									   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
									     ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
									   AND MONTH <= (  SELECT p.horizon_end_date
														 FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
														WHERE ( @Param1='' or @Param1 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param1)
														  AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
																				WHERE ( @Param1='' or @Param1 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param1)
																				  and plan_id < 9999)
													)
										) B
							 ON A.DIVISION_ID	= B.DIVISION_ID
							AND A.ITEM_ID		= B.ITEM_ID
							AND C.PLANT_ID		= B.PLANT_ID

							LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.division_id=A.DIVISION_ID AND P.PLANT_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID AND A.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
							WHERE a.VALID_YN ='Y'
							AND (
									( C.OSP_YN='N' ) OR   -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(C.ATTRIBUTE1,'N') IN ('','N'))
								)
							AND a.DIVISION_ID = @Param1
							and ( @Param2='' or @Param2 is null or i.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
							AND (
									(C.OSP_YN='N' AND B.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL) OR  -- 테이블 변경
									(C.OSP_YN='Y' AND P.daily_capa_qty IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(C.ATTRIBUTE1,'N') IN ('','N'))
								)
							
							-- ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용
							UNION ALL
							SELECT distinct a.ITEM_ID, a.PLANT_SITE_ID, SUBSTRING(i.FLOW_ID,1,5) OPERATION_ID, a.DIVISION_ID
							FROM scm_mst_site_item_priority a (NOLOCK)
							JOIN scp_mst_tact_time_OSP b (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = b.division_id AND a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.PLANT_SITE_ID = b.PLANT_SITE_ID	AND B.VALID_YN='Y'
							LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM i (NOLOCK) ON a.division_id = i.division_id AND a.item_id = i.item_id
							JOIN SCM_MST_SITE C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.SCM_SITE_ID=A.PLANT_SITE_ID AND C.OSP_YN='Y' AND ISNULL(C.ATTRIBUTE1,'N')='Y'
							WHERE a.VALID_YN ='Y'
							AND a.DIVISION_ID = @Param1
							AND ( @Param2='' or @Param2 is null or i.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
					) a
					LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE c WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.PLANT_SITE_ID = c.SCM_SITE_ID AND C.VALID_YN = 'Y'
					order by a.item_id
				END

	END



 ELSE IF @Code = 'LineProdPlanLinePopup'
	BEGIN
		IF @Param1 = 'EE'
			BEGIN
				SELECT
				DISTINCT
						A.LINE_ID						  AS CODE
					,A.LINE_ID + '   ' + A.LINE_NAME  AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].SCM_MST_LINE_SN A WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				INNER JOIN  (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1
								FROM   scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
								AND    b.valid_yn    = 'Y'
								AND    b.segment3    = 'Y' -- Capa 세부 공정 여부
							) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 --AND c.operation_group_id = f.segment3 -- operation group id 에 추가된 operation 만보이도록
				--JOIN scp_mst_tact_time t WITH(NOLOCK) on t.division_id=@Param5 and t.plant_site_id=b.SCM_SITE_ID and t.item_id=@Param6 and t.operation_id=@Param4 and t.line_id=A.LINE_ID
				 JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID , PLANT_ID , LINE_ID
								  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
								 WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = @Param5
								   AND X.ITEM_ID = @Param6
								   AND X.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
								   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
								   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
								   ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
								    AND MONTH <= (  SELECT p.horizon_end_date
													  FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
													 WHERE ( @Param5='' or @Param5 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
													   AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
																			 WHERE ( @Param5='' or @Param5 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
																			   and plan_id < 9999)

)

						) T
				  ON T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
				 AND T.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				WHERE 1=1
				AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y'
				AND A.DIVISION_ID  IN ('40','81','82')
				AND A.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
				AND (@Param2='' OR @Param2 IS NULL OR b.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
				AND b.SCM_SITE_ID = @Param3
				AND (@Param5='' OR @Param5 IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
			END
		ELSE IF @Param1 = 'EE_UC'
			BEGIN
				SELECT
				DISTINCT
						A.LINE_ID						  AS CODE
					,A.LINE_ID + '   ' + A.LINE_NAME  AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].SCM_MST_LINE_SN A WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				INNER JOIN  (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1
								FROM   scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
								AND    b.valid_yn    = 'Y'
								AND    b.segment3    = 'Y' -- Capa 세부 공정 여부
							) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 --AND c.operation_group_id = f.segment3 -- operation group id 에 추가된 operation 만보이도록
				--JOIN scp_mst_tact_time t WITH(NOLOCK) on t.division_id=@Param5 and t.plant_site_id=b.SCM_SITE_ID and t.item_id=@Param6 and t.operation_id=@Param4 and t.line_id=A.LINE_ID
				 JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID , PLANT_ID , LINE_ID
								  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
								 WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = @Param5
								   AND X.ITEM_ID = @Param6
								   AND X.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
								   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
								   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
								   ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
								    AND MONTH <= (  SELECT p.horizon_end_date
													  FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
													 WHERE ( @Param5='' or @Param5 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
													   AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
																			 WHERE ( @Param5='' or @Param5 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
																			   and plan_id < 9999)
													)

						) T
				  ON T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
				 AND T.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				WHERE 1=1
				AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y'
				AND A.DIVISION_ID  = '81_UC'
				AND A.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
				AND (@Param2='' OR @Param2 IS NULL OR b.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2 )
				AND b.SCM_SITE_ID = @Param3
				AND (@Param5='' OR @Param5 IS NULL OR A.DIVISION_ID=@Param5)
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT
				DISTINCT
						A.LINE_ID						  AS CODE
					,A.LINE_ID + '   ' + A.LINE_NAME  AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].SCM_MST_LINE_SN A WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				INNER JOIN  (SELECT DISTINCT b.segment4, b.segment1
								FROM   scm_adm_lookup_master_detail b WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE  b.lookup_type = 'LOCATION_GROUP_ROUTE'
								AND    b.valid_yn    = 'Y'
								AND    b.segment3    = 'Y' -- Capa 세부 공정 여부
							) f ON a.operation_id = f.segment4 --AND c.operation_group_id = f.segment3 -- operation group id 에 추가된 operation 만보이도록
				--JOIN scp_mst_tact_time t WITH(NOLOCK) on t.division_id=@Param1 and t.plant_site_id=b.SCM_SITE_ID and t.item_id=@Param6 and t.operation_id=@Param4 and t.line_id=A.LINE_ID
				 JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID , PLANT_ID , LINE_ID
								  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
								 WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = @Param1
								   AND X.ITEM_ID = @Param6
								   AND X.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
								   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)
								   AND X.TACT_TIME > 0
								    ----- 계획 종료 구간 추가
								    AND MONTH <= (  SELECT p.horizon_end_date
													  FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)
													 WHERE ( @Param1='' or @Param1 is null or P.DIVISION_ID=@Param1)
													   AND p.plan_id     = (SELECT max(plan_id) FROM dbo.scm_mst_plan p WITH(NOLOCK)

WHERE ( @Param1='' or @Param1 is null or X.DIVISION_ID=@Param1)
																			   and plan_id < 9999)
													)
						) T
				  ON T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
				 AND T.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				WHERE 1=1
				AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y'
				AND A.DIVISION_ID  = @Param1
				AND A.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
				AND (@Param2='' OR @Param2 IS NULL OR b.OPERATION_GROUP = @Param2)
				AND b.SCM_SITE_ID = @Param3
				--ESS 외주 Pakcer Line 생산 Target 적용
				UNION
				SELECT
				DISTINCT
					A.LINE_ID						  AS CODE
					,A.LINE_ID + '   ' + A.LINE_NAME  AS NAME
				FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP A WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.DIVISION_ID=A.DIVISION_ID
												 AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=A.SCM_SITE_ID
												 AND S.OSP_YN='Y'
												 AND ISNULL(S.ATTRIBUTE1,'N')='Y'
				JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.DIVISION_ID=B.DIVISION_ID
														  AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=B.PLANT_SITE_ID
														  AND B.ITEM_ID=@Param6
														  AND B.VALID_YN='Y'
														  AND A.LINE_ID=B.LINE_ID
				WHERE A.DIVISION_ID=@Param1
				AND A.SCM_SITE_ID=@Param3
				AND A.VALID_YN='Y'
				UNION
				SELECT '-' AS CODE, '-' AS NAME
				FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@Param1
				AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@Param3
				AND S.VALID_YN='Y'
				AND S.OSP_YN='Y'
				AND ISNULL(S.ATTRIBUTE1,'N') IN ('','N')

			   -- 2022.07.22 Begin
			   UNION
			   
			   SELECT
				DISTINCT
						A.LINE_ID						  AS CODE
					,A.LINE_ID + '   ' + A.LINE_NAME  AS NAME
				FROM [dbo].SCM_MST_LINE_SN A WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].SCM_MST_SITE B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID AND  A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
				
				 JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID, X.ITEM_ID , X.PLANT_ID , X.LINE_ID
								  FROM SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_SN X WITH(NOLOCK)
								  JOIN dbo.SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V A WITH(NOLOCK)
									ON X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
								   AND X.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
								 WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = @Param1
								   AND X.ITEM_ID = @Param6
								   AND X.OPERATION_ID = @Param4
								   AND X.MONTH >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(6),GETDATE(),112)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCP0051_GET_PRODUCTION_PLAN_TARGET]
	 @p_division_id			NVARCHAR(20)
	,@p_scm_site_id			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_line_id				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_item_id				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_from_yyyymmdd		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_to_yyyymmdd			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_program_id			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_sheet_name			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_user_id				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@p_nick_name			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@debug_mode			NVARCHAR(1) = 'F'

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

	SELECT A.TARGET_ID
		 , CONVERT(DATETIME,A.PROD_DATE,23) AS PROD_DATE
		 , A.DIVISION_ID
		 , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
		 , A.ITEM_ID
		 , FI.NICK_NAME		AS NICK_NAME
 		 , A.PLANT_SCM_SITE_ID
		 , A.LINE_ID
		 , A.OPERATION_ID
		 , A.ORDER_TYPE
		 , A.MARKET
		 , A.QTY			AS PLANT_QTY
		 , A.REASON
		 , A.REASON_DETAIL
		 , A.REQUEST_USER_ID
		 , A.CHARGE_USER_ID
		 , A.CONFIRM_USER_ID
		 , A.CONFIRM_YN
		 , A.TARGET_YN
		 , A.INPUT_DATE
		 , A.CONFIRM_DATE
		 , CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(a.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('AC','EC') THEN 'CP'  -- Cell Product
				WHEN SUBSTRING(a.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('AA','EA') THEN 'CA1'  -- Cell Assy
				ELSE ''  
			  END AS CELL_TYPE
		, null AS COUNTRY
		,  (
		   SELECT max(country) FROM  [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE]   WITH(NOLOCK)  
            WHERE  1 = 1  
		      AND  VALID_YN ='Y'  
		      AND  SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
			  AND  SCM_SITE_ID = A.PLANT_SCM_SITE_ID
		  ) AS  COUNTRY2
	  FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_TARGET A WITH(NOLOCK)
	  JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI WITH(NOLOCK)
	    --ON (CASE WHEN @p_division_id IN ('EE','EE_UC') THEN A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END) 	= FI.DIVISION_ID
		ON (CASE WHEN @p_division_id IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID FROM dbo.FN_GET_DIVISION_DIV('EE')) THEN A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ELSE A.DIVISION_ID END) 	= FI.DIVISION_ID --div_commonization
	   AND A.ITEM_ID		= FI.ITEM_ID
	 WHERE 1 = 1
	   AND A.PROD_DATE >= @p_from_yyyymmdd
	   AND A.PROD_DATE <= @p_to_yyyymmdd
	   AND (( @p_division_id		IS NULL OR  @p_division_id		= '' ) OR A.DIVISION_ID			= @p_division_id	)
	   AND (( @p_scm_site_id		IS NULL OR  @p_scm_site_id		= '' ) OR A.PLANT_SCM_SITE_ID	IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_scm_site_id		,',')))
	   AND (( @p_line_id			IS NULL OR  @p_line_id			= '' ) OR A.LINE_ID				IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_line_id			,',')))
	   AND (( @p_item_id			IS NULL OR  @p_item_id			= '' ) OR A.ITEM_ID		LIKE '%' + @p_item_id	+'%')
	   AND (( @p_nick_name			IS NULL OR  @p_nick_name		= '' ) OR FI.NICK_NAME	LIKE '%' + @p_nick_name	+'%')
	 ORDER BY CONFIRM_YN ,  CONFIRM_DATE DESC ,INPUT_DATE DESC

END

IF @v_plant_scm_site_id = @v_WarrantyPlant
						SET @v_temp_dom_exp =  SUBSTRING(@v_market,1,1);
					ELSE
						SET @v_temp_dom_exp =  'D'

					-- target id 생성
					SELECT @v_temp_target_num = MAX(RIGHT(TARGET_ID,3))
					  FROM SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_TARGET
					 WHERE DIVISION_ID			= @v_division_id
					   AND PLANT_SCM_SITE_ID	= @v_plant_scm_site_id
					   AND PROD_DATE			= @v_prod_date
					   AND ITEM_ID				= @v_item_id
					   AND LINE_ID				= @v_line_id
					   AND OPERATION_ID			= @v_operation_id
					   AND ORDER_TYPE			= @v_order_type
					   AND MARKET				= @v_market
						;

					IF @v_temp_target_num IS NULL
					BEGIN
						SET @v_target_id =  @v_division_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_plant_scm_site_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_prod_date + @v_id_delimiter + @v_item_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_line_id+ @v_id_delimiter + @v_operation_id + @v_id_delimiter +  @v_order_type+ @v_id_delimiter	
							+  @v_temp_dom_exp  + @v_id_delimiter + '001';
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @v_temp_target_num = REPLICATE('0',3 - LEN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(3),CONVERT(INT,@v_temp_target_num) + 1))) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(3),CONVERT(INT,@v_temp_target_num) + 1);
						SET @v_target_id = @v_division_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_plant_scm_site_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_prod_date + @v_id_delimiter + @v_item_id + @v_id_delimiter + @v_line_id+ @v_id_delimiter + @v_operation_id + @v_id_delimiter +  @v_order_type+ @v_id_delimiter	
							+  @v_temp_dom_exp  + @v_id_delimiter + @v_temp_target_num;
					END
				
						INSERT INTO SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_TARGET
						(
									  TARGET_ID
									, DIVISION_ID
									, ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
									, ITEM_ID
									, PLANT_SCM_SITE_ID
									, LINE_ID
									, OPERATION_ID
									, ORDER_TYPE
									, MARKET
									, PROD_DATE
									, QTY
									, REASON		
									, REASON_DETAIL
									, REQUEST_USER_ID
									, CHARGE_USER_ID
									, CONFIRM_YN
									, TARGET_YN
									, INPUT_DATE
								)
						VALUES  (
					 				  @v_target_id
									, @v_division_id
									, @v_origin_division_id
									, @v_item_id
									, @v_plant_scm_site_id
									, @v_line_id
									, @v_operation_id
									, @v_order_type
									, @v_market
									, @v_prod_date
									, @v_plant_qty
									, @v_reason
									, @v_reason_detail
									, @v_request_user_id
									, @v_charge_user_id
									, 'N'    -- CONFIRM_YN
									, 'N'    -- TARGET_YN
									, SYSDATETIME()  -- INPUT_DATE
								);
					END
				END  -- END OF STMT. IF( @mst_loop_cnt > 0 )			
		END -- END OF STMT. WHILE LEN(@recv_active_flag) > 0 AND @mst_loop_cnt < @max_loop_cnt

		SET @v_log_type = 'END';
		SET @v_log_message = '########## END of procedure ##########';
		SET @v_description = '';
		SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
		EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
			
		COMMIT TRAN;

		-- 결과코드, 결과 카운트 반환
		SELECT  'S' AS result_code,  @max_loop_cnt AS result_cnt ;

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH 

		  if (xact_state() <> 0) ROLLBACK TRAN; --입력 데이타 롤백 처리

		  BEGIN
			INSERT INTO scm_sys_log_batch (program_name,log_type,log_count,log_message,description,event_date,creation_date,created_by,last_update_date,last_updated_by)
			VALUES (ERROR_PROCEDURE(),'ERROR',NULL,ERROR_MESSAGE(),NULL,SYSDATETIME(),SYSDATETIME(),ERROR_PROCEDURE(),SYSDATETIME(),ERROR_PROCEDURE());

			--IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			--  COMMIT WORK;
		  END;

		  -- error코드, errror 메시지 반환
		  SELECT 'F' AS result_code;
		  SELECT '[' + Convert(NVARCHAR(10), ERROR_NUMBER()) + ']' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
		END CATCH;
	END
